integrity.discriminant_basis: The source defines the open set of forms with nonvanishing discriminant and its projectivization; for homogeneous forms this is the smooth projective hypersurface locus.
integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions, and additivity recovers the projective discriminant.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: arXiv:1407.6838 lists its first submission on 2014-07-25.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A base-B diagonal one-parameter subgroup separates all degree-d monomials. Every monomial hypersurface is singular except xy for binary quadrics.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The source lists Mathematics Subject Classification 14L24 first.

scientific_limitations: The result concerns the projective coefficient space and its discriminant, not the quotient moduli space by projective linear transformations.
Vanishing compactly supported Euler characteristic of the smooth locus does not determine its finer topology.
The proof is elementary after torus localization, so an older unindexed observation may exist.
title: The projective hypersurface discriminant has ambient Euler characteristic
